content: function Read [SWS_DM_01513] Upstream: RS_Diag_04135 virtual auto Read ( ara::core::Span < const ara::core::Byte > response_ data, MetaInfo const &meta_info, CancellationHandler cancellation_ handler) noexcept -> ara::core::Future < std::uint32_t >=0; Reads data chunk from the application. The first or subsequent file/directory info content chunk to be sent back to the UDS client will be composed by the application and copied into the provided by ara::diag Span with up to the requested Span size.
